Here’s a **refined, emotionally-driven LinkedIn “About” section** that aligns with your 90-day Growth Engine™, your three pillars, and the more feminine, trust-based positioning you’re stepping into:

---

**Bethany Gifford | Co-Founder & CEO, The Luxora Collective**

Most aesthetic practices don’t have a lead problem.  
They have a systems problem.

I work with med spa and wellness founders who are doing everything “right” on the surface… yet still feel stuck.  
The fully booked days that don’t translate into real growth.  
The marketing that feels inconsistent.  
The team that struggles to convert.  
The quiet frustration of knowing your business has more potential than what it’s producing.

That’s where we come in.

At The Luxora Collective, we don’t just generate leads.  
We build **complete revenue ecosystems** that transform how your business attracts, converts, and retains high-value clients.

Through our signature 90-day program, **The Luxora Growth Engine™**, we install the three core systems every scalable practice needs:

• **The Market Blueprint™**  
Clarity before spend. We map your market, your positioning, and your most profitable opportunities so every move is intentional.

• **The Conversion Engine™**  
From first click to booked consult. We implement paid ads, AI-driven follow-up, and sales systems that turn interest into committed clients.

• **The Revenue Multiplier™**  
Where real growth happens. We build your memberships, packages, retention systems, and client experience so every new client becomes long-term revenue.

This is not guesswork.  
This is not “more leads and hope it works.”

This is about creating a business that finally feels aligned, controlled, and scalable.

Our clients don’t just grow revenue.  
They gain **clarity, confidence, and control** over their business again.

We partner with aesthetic and wellness practices doing $500K–$3M+ who are ready to stop piecing things together and start operating like a real growth machine.

**What we help you achieve:**
• Consistent, qualified client flow  
• Higher consult-to-treatment conversions  
• Stronger team performance without constant oversight  
• Increased lifetime value through memberships and packages  
• Predictable, scalable monthly revenue  

Because at the end of the day…  
you didn’t build your business to feel overwhelmed, reactive, or uncertain.

You built it for freedom.  
For impact.  
For the ability to grow something extraordinary.

We just help you finally get there.

---

**Signature Programs:**  
The Luxora Growth Engine™  
The Luxora Partnership  
The Luxora Secret Shopper  

---
